profile_text.body:
Google is a public company founded in 1998 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, traded on public markets under the ticker GOOGL. Its own website, centered on the Gemini product, describes Gemini as Google's AI assistant and promotes it as a tool for writing, planning, and brainstorming, framing the offering around generative AI capabilities.

The company's tracked AI products span several categories. Gemini serves as its general large language model assistant, while Google AI Studio is positioned for model prototyping by developers. Google Med-PaLM and MedLM are medical large language models aimed at clinical reasoning and healthcare data applications, with a HIPAA BAA noted as required. Workspace-integrated products include Google Drive AI, Google Meet AI for meeting summaries and live captions, and NotebookLM, which grounds responses in user-uploaded documents. TensorFlow and Keras represent Google's open-source machine learning framework offerings, with TensorFlow Extended covering MLOps use cases.

The held facts show Google filing a 10-K reporting revenue of $402,836,000,000 for the period ending 2025-12-31, under SEC CIK 0001652044. California is recorded as the jurisdiction with the highest legal exposure associated with the company, with 181 cases noted there, though no specific litigation details are held. Google's services also appear as the subject of ten third-party MCP servers in the registry, covering integrations with Google Ads, Google Search Console, Google News, Google Calendar, Google Forms, and Google Trends, built and maintained by various external developers.
